import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect schemas:
    # Source0: ['PLAYER', '2017-18']
    # Source1: ['#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    #
    # Target schema:
    # ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer, 'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float, 'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float, 'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]

    # Transformation plan:
    # 1. The key to join the two sources is the player name.
    #    Source0 has 'PLAYER' and '2017-18' salary.
    #    Source1 has detailed stats with 'Player' as player name.
    # 2. Join df_source0 and df_source1 on df_source0.PLAYER == df_source1.Player
    # 3. After join, reorder columns to match target schema.
    # 4. Ensure data types match target schema.
    # 5. Write the resulting dataframe to the target CSV path.

    # Merge on player name
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, left_on='PLAYER', right_on='Player', how='inner')

    # Reorder columns to target schema
    target_columns = ['PLAYER', '2017-18', '#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 
                      'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']

    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Enforce data types according to target schema
    # PLAYER: string
    df_target['PLAYER'] = df_target['PLAYER'].astype(str)
    # 2017-18: integer
    df_target['2017-18'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['2017-18'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    # #: integer
    df_target['#'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['#'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    # Player: string
    df_target['Player'] = df_target['Player'].astype(str)
    # Team: string
    df_target['Team'] = df_target['Team'].astype(str)
    # GP: integer
    df_target['GP'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['GP'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    # MPG: float
    df_target['MPG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['MPG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FGM: float
    df_target['FGM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FGM'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FGA: float
    df_target['FGA'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FGA'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FG%: float
    df_target['FG%'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FG%'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # 3PM: float
    df_target['3PM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['3PM'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # 3PA: float
    df_target['3PA'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['3PA'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # 3P%: float
    df_target['3P%'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['3P%'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FTM: float
    df_target['FTM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FTM'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FTA: float
    df_target['FTA'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FTA'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # FT%: float
    df_target['FT%'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['FT%'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # TOV: float
    df_target['TOV'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['TOV'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # PF: float
    df_target['PF'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['PF'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # ORB: float
    df_target['ORB'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['ORB'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # DRB: float
    df_target['DRB'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['DRB'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # RPG: float
    df_target['RPG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['RPG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # APG: float
    df_target['APG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['APG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # SPG: float
    df_target['SPG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['SPG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # BPG: float
    df_target['BPG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['BPG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # PPG: float
    df_target['PPG'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['PPG'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
